name: Khajiit
description:
The Khajiit are a feline race with a light step. Their oral tradition says they come from "elsewhere", and nobody seems to know where that is.

They land on their feet, pounce when they sprint, and keep creepers at a distance. The suthay frame is slender: fewer hearts, and a lighter hit. It is also said that they are all worthless moon sugar addicts.
